name: Correlation Studio for JMeter
description: Automates the full release-to-release lifecycle of a JMeter script. Auto-Correlator: detects session tokens, CSRF values, and hidden fields by analyzing a HAR/JTL recording, suggests Regular Expression Extractors, and lets you review and apply them (with a built-in regex tester, NeoLoad-style). Saves correlation rules as reusable templates, organized by project, so the next release's script gets the same correlations applied automatically. Record Scenario: records browser scenarios via Playwright — either a fully scripted, repeatable .js file or a live, click-through interactive session — with named Transaction Controller grouping, text/response-code assertions, and one-time browser rendering-timing and per-request network-timing baselines (DNS/connect/SSL/TTFB/download). Generates a fresh .jmx directly from a HAR recording. Compare Scripts/Recordings: diffs two .jmx/.har/.jtl files — added/removed/changed requests, parameter and body field changes, and Transaction Controller differences — as a color-coded, IDE-style diff, so you can see exactly what the application changed between releases before re-correlating anything. Capture Render Timing Under Load: starts your test plan's own load test, then runs one real browser through your scenario while that load is active, to see what the UI experiences under realistic concurrent load.
